name: HYPD AI for Google Ads, Google Analytics, Meta Ads/Facebook Ads, Keyword Planner & Merchant Center
description:
HYPD helps PPC marketers, agencies, and advertisers analyze advertising performance directly in Claude. Connect your marketing accounts, ask questions in plain language, and get answers based on your real account data.

You can use HYPD to:
- **Audit a Google Ads account:** *"Audit my Google Ads account and show me the top 5 fixes"*
- **Find wasted spend:** *"Where am I wasting ad spend across Google and Meta?"*
- **Optimize for ROAS:** *"Find opportunities to increase ROAS across Google and Meta"*
- **Analyze Meta creatives:** *"Which of my Meta creatives are fatiguing, and what should I refresh?"*
- **Analyze events on GA4:** *"Compare sessions, revenue, and transactions across Reddit, TikTok, Pinterest, Microsoft, LinkedIn, and Amazon Ads"*
- **Check Shopping feeds:** *"List products with approval status and summarize account issues"*
- **Research keywords with Google Keyword Planner:** *"Find keyword ideas for running shoes in the US, with monthly search volume"*
- **Watch competitors:** *"Show the top 5 ads claude.ai is running"*
- **Run Lighthouse landing-page audits:** *"Run a Lighthouse audit on https://example.com/product"*
- **Audit pixel tracking and GTM events:** *"Which tracking pixels and Google Tag Manager tags fire on my landing page?"*

**Capabilities**
**Platforms:** Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Merchant Center, and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
**Analytics:** GA4 also reports traffic and conversions from Reddit Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and Amazon Ads.
**Marketing intelligence:** Google Keyword Planner, Meta Ad Library, Google Ads Transparency Center, Google Shopping, and Google Search (SERP) paid and organic rankings.
**Landing pages:** Lighthouse audits, pixel, conversion-tracking, and Google Tag Manager checks.
**Coming soon:** LinkedIn Ads, Reddit Ads, Pinterest Ads, Microsoft Ads, and Google Search Console.

**Read-only:** HYPD reports on your accounts and never changes your campaigns, budgets, or ads.

_published_faq.name: How do I add HYPD AI for Google Ads, Google Analytics, Meta Ads/Facebook Ads, Keyword Planner & Merchant Center to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HYPD AI for Google Ads, Google Analytics, Meta Ads/Facebook Ads, Keyword Planner & Merchant Center to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hypd.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.
